name: Pirate Cave
note: Safest intro — practice strafing while you shoot. Almost nothing here can kill a careful player.

name: Forest Maze
note: Easy maze for learning to move and shoot. No real threat.

name: Spider Den
note: Webs slow you while spiders swarm — keep moving so the boss can't corner you.

name: Snake Pit
note: Stheno fires aimed lines of shots — strafe sideways through the gaps. Easy early run.

name: Forbidden Jungle
note: Mixcoatl tracks you with shotguns and builds healing totems — destroy the totems or you can't out-damage its healing.

name: Magic Woods
note: Very safe — just kite the boss. Spawns in the Sprite Forest biome.

name: Cave of a Thousand Treasures
note: Timed loot vault, no real threat — grab the bags and leave before it closes.

name: Sprite World
note: Orbit Limon to micrododge her green beams (ranged can snipe from center). ~5 rooms to her room.

name: Ancient Ruins
note: Kite the boss and clear adds as you go; a straightforward desert dungeon.

name: Undead Lair
note: Septavius stays invincible until you kill all his ghosts — clear the ghost ring first, then burn him. Don't get cornered by adds.

name: Abyss of Demons
note: Avoid the lava (slows + burns) and enter rooms through the center. Kill the 6 White Demons before stepping in to damage Archdemon Malphas.

name: Manor of the Immortals
note: Lord Ruthven becomes invulnerable bat clouds + skull turrets — break the wall mirrors for Holy Water to cleanse status; keep your distance from the bishop shotguns.

name: Toxic Sewers
note: Sludge fills every room and inflicts Sick (blocks healing) — fight from the clean grey tiles and dodge the slowing green star before Gulpord the Slime God's shotgun.

name: Cursed Library
note: Thin the adds and learn the boss's phase pattern; manageable solo with range.

name: Mad Lab
note: Dr Terrible's shotgun shreds point-blank — keep range and clear the white coils. Second boss (Horrific Creation): herd it into the blue beams to break its invulnerability.

name: Haunted Cemetery
note: Multi-stage group dungeon — the bosses hit hard, so bring people.

name: Puppet Master's Theatre
note: Don't kill the Puppet Master's clones — they burst into paralyzing shots and spawn puppets. Focus the real boss and drag the puppets into a corner.

name: The Crawling Depths
note: Son of Arachna leaps and lays webs — pop the egg sacks before they hatch into armor-breaking spiders, and don't get cornered.

name: Ice Cave
note: Oryxmas seasonal (Esben the Unwilling). Don't break the ice walls — hide behind them from Esben's spirals and dodge the icicle barrage. Mana + Dex pots, but NO exalt — that moved to its rebuild, the Ice Citadel.

name: Davy Jones's Locker
note: Davy fires expanding spirals and spawns adds — keep your range and thin the spawns.

name: Tomb of the Ancients
note: Wake and kill the three (Bes → Nut → Geb) ONE at a time — AoEing all of them at once creates an un-dodgeable armor-break crossfire. Long-range classes chip them safely.

name: Ocean Trench
note: Thessal's coral bombs split and armor-break — never sit beside a bomb while armor-broken (it Pet-Stasis bursts you).

name: Woodland Labyrinth
note: Maze to the Murderous Megamoth — clear the adds and dodge its aimed bursts.

name: Lair of Draconis
note: Four elemental dragons, each with a gimmick — the white Ivory Wyvern is last and lethal. Learn the patterns before soloing.

name: Deadwater Docks
note: Jon Bilgewater the Pirate King — max DEF first. A wandering Calamity Crab miniboss is brutal but drops boss-tier loot. 75% chance to open a Puppet Master's Encore after the boss.

name: Puppet Master's Encore
note: Harder sequel to the Theatre — same rule: don't pop the clones. Portal is guaranteed from the Daughter of Limon (Sprite Forest) and Maze Minotaur (Abandoned City), or 75% after Deadwater Docks. UTs: The Thousand Shot, Prism of Dire Instability.

name: The Hive
note: A DPS race vs the Queen Bee — kill the drones and dodge her bee-line bursts.

name: Cnidarian Reef
note: Only the single GOLD Cnidarian is vulnerable — shoot it down; the oval bullets pierce armor. Bows hit through the cluster.

name: Lair of Shaitan
note: Huge damage with little room to dodge — bring a maxed group (boss HP scales with player count).

name: Sulfurous Wetlands
note: Veteran-biome swamp — watch the terrain hazards and keep moving; safer with a group.

name: Parasite Chambers
note: Drag the explosive barrels into the Nightmare Colony to crack its armor shell; gory and high armor-break, so bring a group and keep dodging.

name: Secluded Thicket
note: One of the hardest Court dungeons — three bosses and very high damage. Bring a group.

name: Mountain Temple
note: Kill the 4 corner Elementals to expose Daichi (he stands still — great for spells); heavy shots + Pet Stasis make a Priest valuable.

name: Kogbold Steamworks
note: Portal from the Kogbold Expedition Engine encounter (gives a regular AND an Advanced portal). Drag enemies off the traps, clear the Flying Machine miniboss, then the Factory Control Core. GREATER pots; VIT exalt. Advanced = 50% less healing, +30% loot.

name: Ice Citadel
note: Blizzard: a frostbite meter fills in the cold — every 10% costs 5% SPD and at 100% you take damage over time, so don't loiter. Esben the Neurotic grants a guaranteed SPD exalt (the Ice Cave's rebuild).

name: The Shatters
note: Archmage: lock the fire/ice generators then kill his phoenixes. Forgotten King: invincible crystals spawn each pattern — never stand in them. Long & deadly, but BOTH the Archmage and the King grant an ATT exalt (2 per run).

name: The Nest
note: Stay in the gaps of the Queen's spreads and kill worker bees (slow + hardened honey = death). Break nests to choose which Beehemoths spawn. DEX exalt. Hard mode is now the Plagued Nest (50% less healing, +30% loot).

name: Fungal Cavern
note: Break 25 Cavern Crystals to power the drill to the boss; avoid the slow pools and play centered to catch drags. Crystal Worm Mother → WIS exalt + GREATER pots, and she drops the Crystal Cavern entrance.

name: Crystal Cavern
note: Entered from the Fungal Cavern boss (not a seasonal) — run them back-to-back for 2 WIS exalts. The Crystal Entity is pure micrododge-the-telegraphs. GREATER pots + Life.

name: Spectral Penitentiary
note: Four switch-puzzle branches; on Soulwarden Murcian, destroy his 3 keys to break his invulnerability. ATT exalt.

name: Moonlight Village
note: Dance-off bosses — the LAST dancer sets your exalt (Genji=Life, Kaguya=Mana, Miko=Att), so kill the others first. Regular difficulty guarantees a Greater Life pot. (Leisurely drops no exalt.)

name: Lost Halls / Marble Colossus
note: Stick together — the enemy clusters need group DPS. The Marble Colossus grants a DEF exalt; gateway to Cultist (SPD) and The Void (Mana). Drops a Helmet Rune for O3.

name: Cultist Hideout
note: At hallway splits take the one WITHOUT a beam at its entrance. Avoid Malus/Gaius/Basaran's colored beams (armor-break/paralyze/slow); burst Malus after his invuln ring. SPD exalt.

name: The Void
note: The Void Entity is invincible until just after each attack — wait for the vulnerable window to burst, then back out of the leftover shots. Opened with a Vial of Pure Darkness (from Malus). MANA exalt.

name: Oryx's Sanctuary (O3)
note: Needs Sword + Shield + Helmet runes from O2. One of four random minibosses, then Oryx 3. The Celestial phase kills most newcomers — don't panic-run; rotate with the gaps and pre-pot before you flash red. LIFE exalt + 50% chance of a bonus one.
